purchase_intro: Hi {name}, your purchase has been recorded:
invoice_intro: Hi {buyerName}, supplier {supplierName} has issued an invoice for your purchases:
invoice_note: After payment, please mark the invoice as paid in the application.
payment_approved_intro: Hi {buyerName}, supplier {supplierName} has approved your payment for invoice #{id} ({amount} {currency}).
payment_rejected_intro: Hi {buyerName}, supplier {supplierName} has rejected the payment for invoice #{id} ({amount} {currency}).
payment_rejected_note: Please check your payment and try again.
daily_report_intro: Hi {name}, today you purchased {count} items for a total of {total} {currency}:
unpaid_reminder_intro: Hi {buyerName}, invoice #{id} from supplier {supplierName} for {amount} {currency} has not been paid yet.
unpaid_reminder_note: After payment, please mark the invoice as paid in the application.
payment_requested_intro: Hi {supplierName}, customer {buyerName} has marked invoice #{id} ({amount} {currency}) as paid.
pending_approval_intro: Hi {name}, you have {count} invoices totalling {total} {currency} where customers have marked payment as sent:
pending_approval_note: Check payments in your bank account and approve them in the application.
order_cancelled_intro: Hi {buyerName}, your order #{id} for {productName} from supplier {supplierName} for {price} {currency} has been cancelled by an administrator.
order_cancelled_note: If you have the product with you, please return it to its original place.
welcome_intro: Hi {name}, your account has been automatically created. You can now order products from the fridge.
welcome_note: If you have any questions or issues, please contact the system administrator.
welcome_verify_intro: Before you start, please verify your email address.
email_verification_intro: Hi {name}, confirm your email address by clicking the button below.
email_verification_note: If you did not request this change, you can ignore this message.
iban_change_intro: Hi {name}, confirm updating your IBAN to {iban}.
iban_change_note: If you did not request this, ignore this message and secure your account.
restock_intro: Hi {name}, product {productName} from supplier {supplierName} is available again.
payment_withdrawn_intro: Hi {supplierName}, customer {buyerName} has withdrawn the payment notification for invoice #{id} ({amount} {currency}). The invoice is back to awaiting payment status.
purchase_batch_intro: Hi {name}, your kiosk purchase has been recorded:
registration_invite_intro: You have been invited to join {app_name}.
registration_invite_note: If you did not expect this invite, you can ignore this email.
password_reset_intro: We received a request to reset your password for {app_name}.
password_reset_note: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.
price_correction_intro: Hi {name}, a mistyped price of {productName} from supplier {supplierName} has been corrected. The correction applies to your purchases that have not been invoiced yet.
price_correction_note: The corrected price will appear on your next invoice from this supplier. Invoices already issued do not change. Sorry for the trouble.
supplier_change_intro: Hi {name}, someone else changed your records.
supplier_change_note: You can also find the change in Activity. If you did not know about it, contact its author.
supplier_change_subject_storno: Order #{id} from your stock was cancelled
supplier_change_heading_storno: An order from your stock was cancelled
supplier_change_heading_invoice: An invoice was issued for your goods
supplier_change_storno_note: The piece went back to stock.
mcp_connected_subject: AI tool {client} was connected to your account
mcp_connected_intro: Hi {name}, the tool “{client}” has just connected to your account via MCP.
mcp_connected_access: It can act on your behalf – buy items, read orders and invoices and everything else you can do. Access does not expire on its own.
mcp_connected_not_you: If you did not start this connection, revoke the access right away in Profile → API tokens.
